items.title: Israel REJECTS Trump's Gaza 'Peace' Plan
summary_lines: Israel rejected the USA's 15-point Gaza "Board of Peace" colonization plan despite Hamas tentatively agreeing to it.
The plan is framed as a colonization scheme rather than a genuine peace proposal.
items.why: Shows the asymmetry: Hamas signals acceptance while Israel refuses even a US-backed framework.

items.title: He ALREADY Turned
summary_lines: Abdul Al-Sayed won his primary and immediately allied with Kamala Harris and Pete Buttigieg, figures the host labels "genociders."
The move is presented as confirmation that Al-Sayed is an establishment operator, not an anti-establishment savior.
items.why: Illustrates the rapid co-optation of left-primary winners into mainstream Democratic alignments.

items.title: I've Been EXPOSED as RACIST
summary_lines: The host was accused of racism for denying that Argentina committed genocide against all Black people.
The video investigates whether the claim about Argentina's total eradication of its Black population holds.
items.why: Tests a sweeping historical claim about Argentine demographic history against the evidence.

items.title: You Need to Understand This Before You Talk About Latin America
summary_lines: Contrasts British and Spanish colonial models and how each shaped resulting Latin American societies.
Argues that applying US racial frameworks 1:1 to Latin America fails because colonial histories differ fundamentally.
items.why: Provides the colonial-history baseline needed to avoid category errors when analyzing LATAM politics.

items.title: Hamas DISARMING - Have They Surrended?
summary_lines: Media reports circulate about Hamas disarming as part of a US agreement.
Israel has not agreed to the framework, making the disarmament talk premature.
items.why: Highlights the gap between diplomatic leaks and Israeli government acceptance.

items.title: Norman Finkelstein DESTROYS Hasgoy Piker in Anti-Semitism Debate
summary_lines: Hasan Piker invited Norman Finkelstein; Finkelstein spoke on Jewish privilege while Piker raised antisemitism roughly 25 times.
Piker repeatedly attempted to inject "Jewish Exceptionalism" into the discussion, per the host.
items.why: Documents a high-profile left debate where the antisemitism charge is deployed to deflect critique of Jewish privilege.

items.title: Economic Update: DSA Revives Socialism in U.S. Politics
summary_lines: Wolff reports new US rules universally hostile to international students.
DOJ reduced white-collar crime prosecutions while increasing pressure on UAW president Shawn Fain.
Over 200 people in the Caribbean and Pacific killed by US military without lawyers, trials, or judges.
items.why: Connects immigration crackdowns, labor suppression, and extrajudicial killings as facets of the same state apparatus.

items.title: Redneck Gone Green with Erel Onojobi
summary_lines: Erel Anajobi, Program Director for "Power to Prosper" at the Runnymede Trust (UK race-equality think tank), discusses why racial justice and economic justice must be pursued together.
The episode frames power, ownership, and community-led action as the metrics of real change.
items.why: Links a British civil-rights institution's framework to the US redneck-left project of building cross-racial working-class power.

items.title: Profit's Hidden Costs: #shorts #profits #workplace
summary_lines: Asserts profit is not a neutral rule but a mechanism that harms workers.
No further facts provided in description.
items.why: A 60-second provocation to reframe profit as extraction rather than efficiency.

items.title: Capitalism Hits Home: How Economic Shifts Are Reshaping Family Life
summary_lines: Dr. Harriet Fraad and Paul Salvatore trace changes in love, marriage, and family in North America to economic, social, and cultural shifts.
Covers historical role of family, rise of union movements, collective action, and changing gender roles in relationships.
items.why: Grounds personal-life transformations in material conditions rather than cultural drift alone.

items.title: Populism: How They Keep Us Divided
summary_lines: Traces populism from the 1892 American Populist Party platform through European fascism, FDR's New Deal, neoliberal identity politics, to modern MAGA.
Uses a Dialectical and Historical Materialist framework: populism functions as a class-collaborationist mechanism to manage capitalist crisis.
Populists across the spectrum rely on enemy mapping, economism, and class monism to divert frustration into cultural grievances, nativism, and false unity.
items.why: Offers a structural theory of populism as crisis-management for capital, not a genuine popular uprising.

items.title: Here's Why Conservatives Always Back Dictatorships -- #Political #Socialism #historical
summary_lines: No description provided; title claims conservatives consistently support dictatorships.
items.why: Short-form historical argument linking conservative movements to authoritarian backing.

items.title: Zionism's Racist Origins
summary_lines: Hamza Hamouchene argues British officials who created Israel were antisemites solving their own "Jewish question" by externalizing it.
Frames Zionism's core as a colonial bargain between European antisemitism and imperial strategy.
items.why: Reframes Israel's founding as a European antisemitic project, not a Jewish liberation one.

items.title: International Solidarity With Palestine
summary_lines: Hamza Hamouchene connects Vietnam's liberation struggle to Palestinian resistance.
Colonized peoples coordinate across continents, sharing tactics and resources against shared imperial enemies.
items.why: Shows the transnational circuit of anti-colonial knowledge and material support.

items.title: Palestine: No Justice, No Peace
summary_lines: Hamza Hamouchene links the Palestine struggle to Algeria's 132-year fight against French colonialism.
Both are characterized as battles against settler colonialism.
items.why: Uses the Algerian precedent to historicize Palestinian resistance as a classic anti-settler-colonial war.

items.title: Palestinian Struggle for Autonomy
summary_lines: Hamza Hamouchene states Zionism was a white-supremacist colonial project from the start.
Without British sponsorship, there is no Israel; traces the settler-colonial origins.
Full Macro N Cheese episode 391 scheduled for 2026-08-08 at 8am ET.
items.why: Condenses the settler-colonial thesis and points to a long-form source for evidence.

items.title: What is the economy for? Should it help people thrive, or just grow GDP?
summary_lines: Argues economic growth is not an end in itself; endless growth is impossible on a finite planet.
GDP tells remarkably little about whether people thrive; rising GDP has accompanied growing inequality and environmental damage.
Proposes the economy's purpose should be helping everyone live well; markets are tools, not society's purpose.
Introduces capital maintenance — protecting real resources (knowledge, institutions, natural environment) for future generations — a concept accountants grasp but economists ignore.
items.why: Reframes economics from a growth-accounting exercise to a resource-stewardship discipline with intergenerational accountability.

NonCompete: populism as capitalist crisis management
Richard Murphy: replace GDP with capital maintenance

summary_lines: Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya faces escalated abuse after filing a legal challenge to his detention, per family and rights-group testimony.
The retaliation signals a broader warning to families of detained Gaza medical workers pursuing court appeals.
items.why: Documented reprisal against a named physician for using legal channels — a pattern that discourages habeas corpus petitions for hundreds of detained health workers.

items.title: AIPAC-Linked Super PACs, Pro-Israel Donors Flood Primary to Succeed Angie Craig With More Than $3 Million
summary_lines: AIPAC-aligned super PACs and pro-Israel donors have injected over $3 million into Minnesota’s three-way Democratic primary for Angie Craig’s seat.
Progressive candidate Matt Little is the primary target of the spending barrage.
items.why: A single congressional primary draws seven-figure outside spending explicitly coordinated through AIPAC-linked vehicles — a measurable escalation in donor intervention.

items.title: Pro-Israel Pressure Group Honest Reporting Received Grant from Knight Foundation
summary_lines: Honest Reporting, a group with a documented record of endangering Palestinian journalists, received a $100,000 ‘emergency grant’ from the Knight Foundation.
The grant was awarded despite prior criticism of Honest Reporting’s role in targeting Gaza-based reporters.
items.why: A major journalism funder backs an organization accused of facilitating harm to working journalists — a direct contradiction of stated press-freedom principles.

items.title: The Pentagon’s Obsession With China Puts Hawai‘i at Risk
summary_lines: Pentagon war planning for a China conflict positions Hawai‘i as a forward nuclear target, per military documents and basing agreements.
Expanded missile-defense construction and bomber rotations increase the islands’ probability of absorbing a first strike.
items.why: Strategic doctrine converts a civilian population center into a deliberate nuclear sponge without public consent or evacuation planning.

items.title: Sophie Cunningham Is the Anti-Trans Right’s New White Woman Mascot
summary_lines: WNBA player Sophie Cunningham is elevated by right-wing media as the face of ‘protecting women’s sports’ while Black trans athletes are vilified.
The campaign selectively amplifies a white cisgender athlete to legitimize bans that disproportionately affect women of color.
items.why: Racialized framing weaponizes a single athlete’s image to advance legislation that erases trans women of color from competition.

items.title: Rubio Is Trying to Keep Leftists Out of U.S. by Banning Supporters of “Economic Sabotage”
summary_lines: State Department issues new guidance labeling support for ‘economic sabotage’ as grounds for visa denial, explicitly referencing far-left terrorism.
The policy language encompasses Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions (BDS) activism, exposing organizers to entry bans.
items.why: A vague terrorism designation is repurposed to criminalize nonviolent economic pressure campaigns — a legal template for suppressing Palestine solidarity.

items.title: State Department Wants Palantir’s Advice on Free Speech and “Countering Digital Surveillance”
summary_lines: The State Department seeks a consulting contract with Palantir, founded by Peter Thiel, to advise on free speech and digital surveillance countermeasures.
Palantir’s track record includes contracts with ICE, NSA, and Israeli military units; the firm has previously targeted journalists and activists.
items.why: The primary U.S. diplomatic agency hires a surveillance contractor with a history of targeting the press to define the boundaries of free expression online.

items.title: Congress Might Give ICE the Power to Go After Shoplifters
summary_lines: A bipartisan bill framed against ‘organized retail crime’ would designate ICE as the lead federal agency for investigating and prosecuting shoplifting.
The legislation expands immigration enforcement into routine property crimes, creating a pipeline from retail theft arrests to deportation proceedings.
items.why: Mission creep turns a civil immigration agency into a national retail-police force, bypassing local prosecutors and due-process protections.

items.title: Why DJs use the Circle of Fifths
summary_lines: The Camelot Wheel maps musical keys to numbers 1-12 and letters A/B for minor/major, e.g., C major is 8B, A minor is 8A.
Closely related keys in harmonic mixing are those differing by one hour on the Camelot Wheel (e.g., 8B to 7B or 9B) or switching between A/B at same number (e.g., 8A to 8B).
Mixed In Key software analyzes tracks and assigns Camelot Wheel codes; diagonal changes (e.g., 8B to 7A) shift both key and mode, while modal changes stay on same number (e.g., 8B to 8A).
Pitchshifting a track by ±1 semitone changes its Camelot code by one step (e.g., shifting C major 8B up to C# major becomes 9B).
items.why: These concrete rules let DJs plan harmonically compatible mixes without guessing, reducing clashing transitions.

items.title: Why Revolver was revolutionary
summary_lines: Taxman opens with a sharp, staccato guitar riff in 4/4 time, featuring George Harrison's lead vocal and a prominent bassline.
Eleanor Rigby uses a double string quartet (eight violins, two violas, two cellos) playing a staccato E minor chord pattern with no Beatles instruments.
I'm Only Sleeping features Lennon's vocals recorded at half-speed then played back normal, creating a dreamy, lagging effect against the backing track.
Love You To is the first Beatles song to use Indian instrumentation, specifically tabla played by Anil Bhagwat and sitar by George Harrison.
items.why: These specific studio techniques and arrangements show how Revolver broke from pop norms and expanded rock's sonic palette.
